name: NeRF-HuGS
definition: A paradigm that enhances the separation of static scenes from transient distractors in NeRF training by combining hand-crafted heuristics (SfM-based and color residual) with state-of-the-art segmentation models (SAM).
summary: NeRF-HuGS is a NeRF training procedure that mitigates transient artifacts by fusing SfM and residual heuristics to guide SAM in generating precise static masks.
